engine: OpenJK codemp client (openjk.app) - CGVM_* wrappers (cl_cgameapi.cpp) drive vmMain
note: the engine->module side. arg index N in `args[]` is the raw vmMain word `argN` (no trap-number prefix, unlike trap-shapes.json). MANY arms carry their real payload not in the arg words but through `cg.sharedBuffer` (the 2048-byte region registered by the CG_SET_SHARED_BUFFER trap, 344): the engine stages a struct there before the VM call and reads results back after. Those arms carry a `shared_buffer` field (in/out/inout) and the recorder dumps the whole 2048-byte region at ENTER and EXIT. `ptr_opaque` returns an engine-meaningful host pointer the recorder logs as a token (no deref). `ptr_deref` returns a pointer the engine reads/writes THROUGH later; the recorder dereferences `size_of` bytes at EXIT. See README.md 'vmMain export shapes'.

exports.name: CG_INIT
exports.note: CG_Init registers the shared buffer (CG_SET_SHARED_BUFFER) during this call; every later shared_buffer arm depends on it.

exports.name: CG_SHUTDOWN
exports.note: recorder flushes and closes the journal on EXIT of this arm.

exports.name: CG_CONSOLE_COMMAND
exports.note: qboolean - qfalse when the command is not cgame's.

exports.name: CG_POINT_CONTENTS
exports.note: reads TCGPointContents { vec3_t mPoint; int mPassEntityNum; } from cg.sharedBuffer; returns contents mask.

exports.name: CG_GET_LERP_ORIGIN
exports.note: reads TCGVectorData.mEntityNum, writes mPoint (vec3) back into cg.sharedBuffer.

exports.name: CG_GET_LERP_DATA
exports.note: reads TCGGetBoltData.mEntityNum, writes mOrigin/mScale/mAngles back (FX getboltmat feed).

exports.name: CG_GET_GHOUL2
exports.note: returns (int)cg_entities[arg0].ghoul2 - a CGhoul2Info_v* host handle. DEAD in OpenJK: no CGVM_ wrapper reads it (grep codemp/ finds no caller); Raven's own comment says effect bolting 'is actually not used at all'. Recorder logs the return word as an opaque token, no deref.

exports.name: CG_GET_MODEL_LIST
exports.note: returns (int)cgs.gameModels - a pointer to the module's model-handle array. DEAD in OpenJK: no CGVM_ wrapper reads it. Recorder logs the return word as an opaque token, no deref.

exports.name: CG_TRACE
exports.note: reads TCGTrace start/mins/maxs/end/skip/mask, writes mResult (trace_t) back into cg.sharedBuffer.

exports.name: CG_G2TRACE
exports.note: same TCGTrace shape as CG_TRACE, ghoul2-aware.

exports.name: CG_G2MARK
exports.note: reads TCGG2Mark { shader,size,start,dir } from cg.sharedBuffer; no writeback.

exports.name: CG_RAG_CALLBACK
exports.note: the shared-buffer struct depends on callType (ragCallbackDebugBox/DebugLine/BoneSnap/TraceLine); RAG_CALLBACK_TRACELINE writes tr back, so inout. always returns 0.

exports.name: CG_INCOMING_CONSOLE_COMMAND
exports.note: would read/rewrite TCGIncomingConsoleCommand in cg.sharedBuffer, but the body is #if 0 in retail - always returns 1 and touches nothing. shared_buffer flagged for the live mod hook that never ships.

exports.name: CG_GET_ORIGIN

args.note: engine-supplied out vec3 (arg1); VectorCopy of currentState.pos.trBase

exports.note: arg1 is reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(out) - the engine's vec3 the module fills.

args.note: engine-supplied out vec3 (arg1); VectorCopy of currentState.apos.trBase

exports.name: CG_GET_ORIGIN_TRAJECTORY
exports.note: returns (int)&cg_entities[arg0].nextState.pos. The engine (RoffSystem.cpp:876,1023) reads AND writes through it - SetLerp(originTrajectory, TR_LINEAR/TR_STATIONARY, ...) at RoffSystem.cpp:903,924,939. Recorder dereferences 36 bytes (trajectory_t: q_shared.h:2654-2660) at EXIT.

exports.name: CG_GET_ANGLE_TRAJECTORY
exports.note: returns (int)&cg_entities[arg0].nextState.apos; same engine read/write via RoffSystem SetLerp(angleTrajectory, ...). Recorder dereferences 36 bytes at EXIT.

exports.name: CG_IMPACT_MARK
exports.note: reads TCGImpactMark (handle/point/angle/rotation/rgba/size) from cg.sharedBuffer; the old raw-arg form is commented out at the site.

exports.name: CG_MAP_CHANGE
exports.note: sets cg.mMapChange; may be called more than once per map change.

exports.name: CG_AUTOMAP_INPUT

args.note: arg0 - non-0 means a one-frame mouse event

exports.note: reads autoMapInput_t from cg.sharedBuffer into cg_autoMapInput.

exports.name: CG_MISC_ENT
exports.note: reads TCGMiscEnt (model name + placement) from cg.sharedBuffer (RMG static ents).

exports.name: CG_GET_SORTED_FORCE_POWER
exports.note: returns forcePowerSorted[arg0]. Declared out of enum order in the switch (sits between CG_TRACE and CG_G2TRACE) but numbered 30.

exports.name: CG_FX_CAMERASHAKE
exports.note: reads TCGCameraShake { mOrigin, mIntensity, mRadius, mTime } from cg.sharedBuffer.
